siteDomain.title: Own domain
siteDomain.description: Serve this site under your own address. The Pukalani address stays and redirects there.
siteDomain.fieldHelp: Enter the form the site should live under — with or without www. We set up the other form as well and redirect it here.
siteDomain.savedDesc: Now create the DNS records below, then press Check.
siteDomain.checkAgain: Not there yet. DNS changes sometimes take a few minutes — press Check again later.
siteDomain.pendingTitle: This is where it is stuck
siteDomain.removeConfirmText: After this {domain} no longer works and the site lives at {host} again. Content stays untouched.
siteDomain.fallbackNote: Your Pukalani address {host} stays and redirects to the own domain.
siteDomain.unreachableTitle: Domain management is unreachable right now
siteDomain.unreachableDesc: Own domains are managed centrally, and that connection is not answering. The site itself is unaffected — try again later.
siteDomain.noPloiTitle: No server is on file for this site yet
siteDomain.noPloiDesc: Without a server and site id the certificate cannot be ordered. The operator adds both in the website register; DNS and proof stay as they are until then.
siteDomain.dnsTitle: What to enter at your domain provider
siteDomain.dnsDescription: Copy the records exactly. Then press Check above.

status.pending_cert: DNS is in place. The certificate is being issued.
status.pending_platform: Almost done — the last step is running.

dns.txt: 1. Proof that the domain is yours
dns.txtHelp: A TXT record. It stays as long as the domain is used here.
dns.aHelp: An A record to our server address.
dns.cnameHelp: A CNAME record. Some providers call this an alias.
dns.note: Depending on your provider, DNS changes take a few minutes to a few hours to reach everyone.

errors.domain_invalid: That does not look like a domain. Letters, digits and hyphens are allowed; use the punycode form for non-ASCII names (xn--...).
errors.domain_not_a_domain: That is not a complete domain. It needs at least one dot, for example example.com.
errors.domain_operator_domain: Addresses under pukalani.app cannot be added here — this site already has its Pukalani address.
errors.domain_not_ready: The status changed. Reload the page and check again.
errors.generic: That did not work just now. Please try again.
